title: Deep Dream
description: "Deep Dreams" tells the story of the bygone days of old Minecraft and how many of us want to bring that feeling back... But it's not just about memories of the past, it's also about how even back then, not everything was so rosy.
body:
Are you really will do anything for your past? #$#E WAKE UP...
_It's just another bad dream...._
Don't Let the **It** take you...

_**This Modpack About Dreams and the old days of Minecraft, when we were younger and the grass was greener. But isn't our memory always about the white path? There's also something here that frightened us, something that haunted us all the time. You must find the truth and escape from this dream and leave the past behind...**_
